regime_context: Hong Kong's detector shows a narrow (24% eligible) but genuinely durable leadership pocket: Energy (H-shares) leads with a strong 0.76 durability bar, trend Hurst and 80% breadth, while Banks sit second, crowded at z=1.09 but with a mean-revert Hurst (not a trending stay). The absolute-trend gate is validated here (gate_helps true) and the state is not one-narrative (absorption 0.46, directional false), so this is a regime to lean only defensively — leadership is real but rotation is narrow and the macro backdrop is 100% unscheduled-surprise, so convictions stay modest.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the challenger Banks theme converts its mean-revert tag into a trend tag AND its crowding_z drops back below 0.8 while durability stays above 0.6 — that would be a CONFIRMED leadership handoff worth re-leaning; until then, treat Banks as capped, not preferred. Retire this watch if Banks' durability_bar falls under 0.5 or Energy's margin over Banks widens back above 0.3.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only theme combining the detector's strongest durability (0.76, trend Hurst, 80% breadth) with an uncrowded texture (z=0.38) AND eligibility — the one leg that has always mattered (the absolute-trend gate) is strongly positive here. The lean is a directional stay-in leadership, not a return forecast: rank/durability name it as the prevailing narrative, and nothing in the state argues for exiting it early.
evidence: rotation margin 0.136 over Banks with absorption 0.46 (not one-narrative, so leadership has room but is contested)
theses.dissent: Energy leadership in HK is frequently a crude-oil beta call; if Brent stalls while policy-driven A-share (Banks) keep grinding, the high-durability energy trend can still chop without rolling over — durability only means the gate holds, not that it pays.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) durability_bar falls below 0.5 and its breadth drops below 0.6 before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the rotation challenger (score 1.382, margin only 0.136), eligible and with high durability 0.63 — but they are crowded (z=1.09) and tagged mean-revert. Crowding is a SIZE-DOWN, not a fade: the call is a conditional overweight of the leadership challenger only if it holds the gate, not a momentum chase.
theses.dissent: The mean-revert Hurst plus crowding z=1.09 is exactly the texture that historically marks a theme near a cap — the detector itself says flow spikes can mark tops, so an overweight here risks paying into a crowd that has already arrived.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) durability_bar breaks below 0.5 or its crowding_z stays above 1.0 while breadth drops under 0.6 before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips sit third with durability 0.73, 75% breadth, and uncrowded z=0.12 — a defensive-quality theme with the same staying-power profile as Energy but without the cyclicality. In a 100% unscheduled-surprise macro regime, the income/quality sleeve is the natural trend-following de-risk, supported entirely by the validated gate leg.
evidence: macro_narrative unscheduled_share 1.0 (surprise-prone regime favours defensive leadership)
theses.dissent: Yield-seeking flows in HK are policy-sensitive; if risk-on China stimulus resumes decisively, the defensive sleeve lags and the 'mixed' Hurst means the trend is not clean enough to keep a hard gate.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips breadth falls below 0.6 and durability_bar breaks below 0.55 before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
